description:
AlloQuant is a two-module analysis suite that turns AlphaFold3 structural ensembles into quantitative readouts of kinase regulation.

Module 1 assigns canonical kinase landmarks by profile-HMM alignment to the Pfam Pkinase model, so one definition applies across the kinome without depending on fixed residue numbering, then measures inter-landmark distances and angles and makes categorical conformational calls. Module 2 discovers metastable states without supervision, quantifies internal network rigidity as the mean absolute correlation (MAC) among those measurements, and identifies sub-angstrom differential drivers between conditions or between states.

The repository also archives, under data/, the derived tables from which every number reported in the accompanying paper is computed, together with the AlloQuant master CSV data dictionary and output-file manifest under docs/.
